# PhytoFlex Gold - Clinical-Grade Joint & Mobility Supplement

## About
PhytoFlex Gold is a clinical-strength botanical supplement engineered with 12 high-altitude botanical extracts. It is a 94% bio-available liquid formula designed to modulate molecular inflammation and restore joint, nerve, and muscle vitality at a cellular level. Manufactured by Liquid Health Inc., based in New Delhi, India.

- **Full Name:** PhytoFlex Gold

## Key Ingredients (12 Botanicals)
1. **Boswellia Serrata** - Active 5-LOX inhibition via high-potency AKBA acids
2. **Nirgundi** (Vitex negundo) - Bio-active analgesic with muscle relaxant properties
3. **Rosehip** (Rosa canina) - GOPO bio-actives for cartilage membrane support
4. **Malkangni** (Celastrus paniculatus) - Neuro-signaling enhancement and cognitive clarity
5. **Hadjod** (Cissus quadrangularis) - Bone-setting herb for calcium absorption
6. **Fenugreek** (Trigonella foenum-graecum) - Metabolic catalyst enhancing bioavailability
7. **Ashwagandha** (Withania somnifera) - Adaptogenic cortisol management
8. **Young Bamboo** - High-silica source for collagen synthesis and bone density
9. **Rasna** (Pluchea lanceolata) - Ayurvedic relief for neuralgic discomfort
10. **Curcumin** (from Turmeric) - NF-κB pathway modulation and COX-2 inhibition
11. **Ginger** (Zingiber officinale) - PGE2 synthesis blocking and circulation support
12. **Shatavari** (Asparagus racemosus) - Anti-inflammatory and tissue regeneration support
